reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-random message to confirm the correction: the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due **24 September**, not the 20 November they posted in #north-team this morning.

I also pointed out a problem with the new date. Today is 14 October, so 24 September has already passed. I asked Ilse to check whether it's the wrong year or another misread line.

Ilse asked for no action, so I didn't change anything in #north-team. That channel still shows the 20 November date, and my earlier thread reply there confirmed it. I offered to post a correction in that thread if Ilse wants one.

The brain saves Ilse's message automatically, so I didn't write a separate note. The deadline is a signing date, which counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so posting it in #north-random was fine.
